content.title: THE R&B TOUR: Chris Brown & USHER - AT&T Stadium
content.text: THE R&B TOUR: Chris Brown & USHER September 10, 2026 Sign Up For Presale THE R&B TOUR starring GRAMMY award winning artists Usher Raymond and Chris Brown comes to AT&T Stadium on September 10, 2026. Don’t miss two of R&B’s defining hitmakers hit the stage in Arlington! Sign up for artist presale by April 21 at 9pm CT to get access to tickets before the general public. Tickets will go on sale Monday, April 27 at 12PM at SeatGeek.com.
